# MyBatis 3 Internal Architecture Guide (Unofficial · PNI501 + Drawlib Demo)

> Unofficial bilingual (English/Japanese) source-code architecture guide for MyBatis 3 v3.6.0 — 3-tier package topology, XML/annotation bootstrap builders, JDK dynamic MapperProxy dispatch, L1/L2 Executor & Interceptor pipeline, OGNL…

## Overview

- [Architecture Overview](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/en/): MyBatis 3 (org.mybatis:mybatis) is engineered around a 3-Tier Layered Data-Mapper & Interceptor Pipeline rather than a heavyweight stateful Unit-of-Work /…

- [3. MapperProxy Dispatch](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/en/03_mapper_proxy_engine.html): One of MyBatis 3's signature ergonomic features is that application developers write only a Java interface (e.g., UserMapper) without any concrete…
- [4. Executor, Cache & Plugins](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/en/04_executor_and_caching.html): Every SqlSession delegates database operations to an org.apache.ibatis.executor.Executor created via Configuration.newExecutor(Transaction, ExecutorType)…
- [5. Dynamic SQL & OGNL AST](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/en/05_dynamic_sql_and_ognl.html): MyBatis 3's Dynamic SQL engine (org.apache.ibatis.scripting.*, 25 source files) uses the Interpreter and Composite design patterns to turn XML tags (…
- [6. ResultSet & Reflection](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/en/06_resultset_and_reflection.html): Once the JDBC driver returns a ResultSet, DefaultResultSetHandler (src/main/java/org/apache/ibatis/executor/resultset/DefaultResultSetHandler.java, 1,300+…
